item.title: Extreme cold watch in place for North Country for Saturday and Sunday — dangerously cold wind chills
item.description: The National Weather Service issued an extreme cold watch at 12:11 a.m. on Thursday valid from Saturday 7 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for St. Lawrence, Franklin, Clinton and Essex counties.

item.title: Clinton and Essex counties placed under an extreme cold watch Saturday and Sunday — wind chills as low as -30
item.description: On Thursday at 12:11 a.m. an extreme cold watch was issued by the National Weather Service valid from Saturday 6 p.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Clinton and Essex counties.

item.title: Parts of Upstate NY under an extreme cold watch Saturday and Sunday
item.description: An extreme cold watch was released by the National Weather Service on Thursday at 12:49 a.m. valid from Saturday 4 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Oneida, Yates, Seneca, Cayuga, Onondaga, Steuben, Schuyler, Chemung, Tompkins, Madison, Cortland, Chenango, Otsego, Tioga, Broome, Delaware and Sullivan counties.

item.title: Parts of Upstate NY placed under an extreme cold watch Saturday and Sunday — dangerously cold wind chills
item.description: An extreme cold watch was issued by the National Weather Service on Thursday at 12:51 a.m. valid from Saturday 7 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Herkimer, Hamilton, Fulton, Montgomery, Schoharie, Schenectady, Albany, Greene and Ulster counties.

item.title: Capital Region placed under an extreme cold watch Saturday and Sunday — extremely cold conditions
item.description: At 12:51 a.m. on Thursday, the National Weather Service released an extreme cold watch valid from Saturday 6 p.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Northern Warren and Southeast Warren as well as Saratoga, Washington, Schenectady, Albany, Rensselaer, Greene, Columbia, Ulster and Dutchess counties.

item.title: Extreme cold watch affecting Western NY and Finger Lakes Saturday and Sunday — extremely cold wind chills
item.description: An extreme cold watch was issued by the National Weather Service on Thursday at 1:01 a.m. valid from Saturday 1 a.m. until Sunday 10 a.m. for Niagara, Orleans, Monroe, Wayne, Cayuga, Erie, Genesee, Wyoming, Livingston, Ontario, Chautauqua, Cattaraugus and Allegany counties.

item.title: Extreme cold watch in place for Central NY and North Country for Saturday and Sunday — wind chills as low as -35
item.description: At 1:01 a.m. on Thursday, the National Weather Service released an extreme cold watch valid from Saturday 7 a.m. until Sunday 1 p.m. for Oswego, Jefferson and Lewis counties.
